- builder(JsonSchemaFactory blueprint) copies config.

- newJsonSchema (protected) indirectly via getSchema methods.

- create(ValidationContext,...)

- findMetaSchemaForSchema: test when $schema present, when absent, when non-textual.

- fromId: test known dialect detection and unknown leads exception.

- getUriFactory returns same.

- getUriTranslator returns translator combining map.

- getSchema(String) with valid JSON string.

- getSchema(String) with invalid JSON -> exception.

- getSchema(InputStream) similar.

- Test enableUriSchemaCache false.

- Test isYaml detection.

- normalizeMetaSchemaUri: test conversion to https.

Also need URNFactory maybe null.

Simplify: use builder().defaultMetaSchemaURI(JsonMetaSchema.getV4().getUri()).addMetaSchema(JsonMetaSchema.getV4()).build();

Test caching: call getSchema twice and assert same instance (==) when cache enabled.

When cache disabled: builder().enableUriSchemaCache(false)... then call twice and assert not same.

Edge case: getSchema with invalid URI (bad syntax) should throw JsonSchemaException.

Also test findMetaSchemaForSchema when $schema is non textual (e.g., {"$schema": 123}) expecting JsonSchemaException.
